rules.title: Every dataset has a declared owner and source
rules.rationale: Checks presence of owner and source declarations only; not their truth.

rules.title: Every dataset carries one or more owner-declared data classes
rules.rationale: Classes must come from the declared class list; legal categories are overlays, not defaults (D-05).

rules.title: Every dataset names one or more declared purposes
rules.rationale: Presence and reference integrity of purposes only; adequacy of a purpose is not judged.

rules.title: Every field is mapped to a declared purpose of its dataset
rules.rationale: A field with no mapped purpose is an unmapped collection; this is a minimization signal, not a legal finding. Absent field list is not-evaluated.

rules.title: Retention period, trigger and mechanism are declared
rules.rationale: Period must be an ISO 8601 duration; indefinite retention needs a complete, unexpired exception. Malformed periods are never guessed.

rules.title: A backup and replica statement accompanies each retention declaration
rules.rationale: Deletion claims that ignore backups are incomplete; presence of the statement only.

rules.title: Deletion is backed by referenced, unexpired supporting evidence
rules.rationale: Absent reference is not-evaluated, never a pass. The evidence must target this rule, support it, and be within validity.

rules.title: Evidence envelopes are well-formed and honestly attributed
rules.rationale: Unknown fields and live-platform surfaces are refused; agent or tool output is never an attestation or legal review; limitations are mandatory.

rules.title: Exceptions state owner, rationale, scope, evidence and an unexpired review date
rules.rationale: An incomplete or expired exception is a finding and grants nothing.
